crossRefs.note: “Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn’t enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, is a…
Jesus therefore said to them again, “Most certainly, I tell you, I am the sheep’s door.
Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.
Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;
through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
For through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.
Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus,
Yahweh is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing.
Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.
for he is our God. We are the people of his pasture, and the sheep in his care. Today, oh that you would hear his voice!
Know that Yahweh, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.
He will feed his flock like a shepherd. He will gather the lambs in his arm, and carry them in his bosom. He will…
saying to those who are bound, ‘Come out!’; to those who are in darkness, ‘Show yourselves!’ “They shall feed along the…
They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun strike them: for he who has mercy on them will lead…
As a shepherd seeks out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered abroad, so I will seek out…
I will strengthen them in Yahweh; and they will walk up and down in his name,” says Yahweh.

translations.web: I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out, and will find pasture.
translations.bsb: I am the gate. If anyone enters through Me, he will be saved. He will come in and go out and find pasture.
translations.kjv: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.
translations.asv: I am the door; by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and go out, and shall find pasture.
